lines: A four-slice sample player: a loaded sample is cut into four slices and each trigger plays the next one, every slice having its own speed, direction, gate output and effects loop.
Sets how fast that slice plays back, and so its pitch.
Scales that slice's Speed CV before it reaches the speed; at the full clockwise setting the CV tracks 1V per octave.
Reverses the direction that slice plays in.
Takes that slice in or out of the rotation, so the mode passes over it.
Sets the fade in and the fade out applied at the two ends of every slice as it plays.
Scales the Fade CV before it reaches the fade time.
Chooses which slice plays next: Forward, Backwards, Ping-Pong, Random or Addressable. Click it to step through the five.
Plays the next slice, as a trigger arriving at the Trigger input does.
Sets where in the sample the four slices are cut.
Scales the Slice Spread CV before it reaches the cut points.
Sets the rotation back, so the next trigger plays the first slice again.
Shifts that slice's playback speed, tracking 1V per octave when that slice's attenuverter is at the full clockwise setting.
A rise above 2V reverses the direction that slice plays in.
A rise above 2V takes that slice in or out of the rotation.
The left side of the audio coming back from that slice's external effect, mixed into the output.
The right side of the audio coming back from that slice's external effect, mixed into the output.
A rise above 2V plays the next slice. In Addressable mode it is read as a level instead, each whole volt from 1V upward picking the slice of that number.
Shifts the fade in and fade out time, scaled by the Fade attenuverter.
Shifts where the sample is cut into slices, scaled by the Slice Spread attenuverter.
A rise above 2V sets the rotation back, so the next trigger plays the first slice again.
The left side of the mix of every slice that is playing.
The right side of the mix of every slice that is playing.
The left side of that slice's audio, to be sent out to an external effect and brought back at that slice's Return.
The right side of that slice's audio, to be sent out to an external effect and brought back at that slice's Return.
High while that slice is playing.
Note — the module is silent until a sample is loaded, from Load Sample on the panel menu, and until a clock or trigger reaches the Trigger input.
Note — a sample plays back at its recorded speed only when Rack is running at the sample rate the file was recorded at.
Menu — Load Sample — reads a WAV or AIF/AIFF file into the module.
Menu — Save Sample — writes the loaded audio back out as Wav or as Aif/Aiff, without the fade, speed or direction the panel applies.
Menu — Clear Sample — empties the module of the audio it holds.
Menu — Exclude Direct Sends: No, Yes — No sends every slice to the output mix; Yes keeps out of the mix any slice whose Send is patched and whose Return is not.

MiniTruffles.notes: There is no published source: sourceUrl is empty in the installed plugin.json and the maker's repository holds only the manuals and two changelogs. Everything here comes from the v2.1.0 manual PDF, the installed panel image res/MiniTruffles.png, the census names, and a disassembly of the unstripped plugin.dylib. Load Sample is a parameter (index 22) with no widget on the panel, so it has no line and no tag; it is reachable only as the Load Sample item on the panel menu. The trigger, flip, active and reset jacks latch against 2V rather than the 1V a button uses, so a 1V trigger does not fire them; 2.0 is an fmov immediate and will not show up as a stored literal. The Mode switch prints Backwards where the manual page writes Backward.

lines: Two loopers in one module, one holding five seconds and one holding half a second, each with its own speed, direction, level, pan and outputs, mixed down to a common stereo pair.
Starts and stops recording into that section.
Reverses the direction that section plays in.
Sets how loud that section is in the output mix.
Places that section between the left and right outputs.
Steps the speed quantisation for that section through none, Octaves, and Octaves + 5ths.
Sets how fast that section plays back, and so its pitch.
Left-click to mute that section, right-click to solo it; a second right-click puts the other sections back.
Sets the chance that the section loops round again instead of stopping at the end of a play.
In Randomize mode, the chance that a trigger at that modifier's input gives the parameters it is set to a new random value.
Steps that modifier between Randomize and Direct CV. Click and hold it to choose which parameters the modifier reaches.
In Direct CV mode, scales that modifier's input before it replaces the value of the parameters the modifier is set to.
Audio into every section whose own In jack is empty.
Audio into that section, used in place of the common Input for it.
The voltage that modifier acts on: a trigger in Randomize mode, a value in Direct CV mode.
A rise above 2V starts that section playing.
The left side of the mix of every section that is not muted.
The right side of the mix of every section that is not muted.
That section's audio on its own, after its level, pan and fades.
A trigger each time that section starts a play.
A trigger each time that section reaches the end of a play.
Note — both loopers are empty when the module is placed, so nothing comes out until audio is patched in and a Rec button is pressed.
Note — the fade in and the fade out of a section are set by dragging the left and the right edge of its waveform display; neither can be clicked for help.
Note — a bar beside each section shows that section's own level; it is a drawing and cannot be clicked.
Menu — Exclude Connected Outputs: No, Yes — No sends every section to the output mix; Yes keeps out of the mix any section whose Out jack is patched.
Menu — Clear Sample — empties one looper of the audio it holds, chosen from the submenu.
Menu — Clear ALL Samples — empties both loopers of the audio they hold.

MiniHyphae.notes: There is no published source: sourceUrl is empty in the installed plugin.json and the maker's repository holds only the manuals and two changelogs. Everything here comes from the v2.1.0 manual PDF, the installed panel image res/MiniHyphae.png, the census names, and a disassembly of the unstripped plugin.dylib. Input index 1 is configured with no name and has no jack on the panel, so it has no line and no tag. The census records the same position for the three Randomize knobs, the three Modifier Mode switches, the three attenuverters and the three modifier jacks, and those positions fall near the top left of the panel while the Modifiers row is drawn across the bottom: the whole row appears to be measured inside its own container. The three modifiers are identical to one another, so one line covers each set; the Randomize knob and the Direct CV attenuverter share a position because they are the same knob under the two modifier modes, and both are tagged. The trigger jacks latch against 2V rather than the 1V a button uses, so a 1V trigger does not fire them; 2.0 is an fmov immediate and will not show up as a stored literal.
